data.one_liner: Provides SHA, MD5, and HMAC hashing functions for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Implements common cryptographic hash algorithms (SHA‑1/224/256/384/512, MD5) and HMAC support. All code is pure Dart and works on every Flutter platform.
use_when: You need to compute hashes or HMACs locally in a Dart/Flutter app.
You require a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies.
avoid_when: You require algorithms not provided (e.g., Argon2, RSA).
strengths: Supports a wide range of hash functions and HMAC
weaknesses: Limited to hashing/HMAC, no encryption or key management
May lack the latest cryptographic primitives
